k-anthropic.title: Anthropic $ANT IPO coins
k-anthropic.sourceSays: Posts say Anthropic is set to price its IPO on Nov 18 with $ANT trading on Nasdaq from Nov 19, and that X already supports the $ANT ticker. Coins named for it are unaffiliated.
k-anthropic.reason: Posts of Nov 11-13 describe the reported Anthropic IPO and $ANT listing; the coins opened 0.5-3.7h ago, after the story began, and are namesakes.
